prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset for the existing Lumine (female Traveler, Genshin Impact) 2D fighting-game sprite animation. Input image 1 is the exact character design and ready-stance reference. Input image 2 is the existing FIRST light attack, for costume, sword, body proportions and pixel-art style reference ONLY; create NEW arm/leg/torso poses, not copies of those poses. Same slim natural 6.5-head proportions, blonde bob, white flowers, white/pale blue/gold dress, blue trailing scarf, white boots, ONE straight silver sword with dark grip and gold crossguard. Face RIGHT in every pose, weapon in her RIGHT hand. Right fist must wrap the dark grip behind the crossguard; blade extends from the opposite side of crossguard; pommel behind the fist, no floating blade, no hand holding blade, exactly two arms, two hands. Clean crisp limited-color pixel illustration with large simple readable color clusters, no antialias glow or painterly texture. True transparent alpha, no scenery, shadows, text, labels, cell lines, slash trails, spell effects or extra weapons. FOUR full-body key poses in a precisely aligned TWO columns by TWO rows sprite sheet, read top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Same anatomical body scale and full sword length in all cells. Give each cell huge clear transparent gutters around the complete sword/scarf so NO two characters or swords touch or overlap. Keep a generous canvas margin. Generate LIGHT ATTACK SECOND HIT: a returning diagonal rising sword cut, clearly different from the first forward horizontal slash. Pose1: low compact preparation after the first cut, sword hilt beside forward right hip, tip low to the right. Pose2: strong diagonal rising slash toward the RIGHT at torso-height with front foot firmly planted, wrist and elbow physically connected to hilt, chest rotates. Pose3: rising-cut follow-through, sword ahead and above her right shoulder, weight settled, scarf follows the rotation. Pose4: controlled recovery to the exact mother ready stance, sword lowered diagonally forward. No magical sword trails. Maintain the same grounded foot line in each row. This sheet is only the SECOND hit, not a whole combo.
